system.description: God of excess and self-fulfilment: indulge yourself and ignore advice and social mores; any pursuit taken to extremes, from art to perfection of skill, counts as worship.
system.summary: God of excess and self-fulfilment: indulge yourself and ignore advice and social mores; any pursuit taken to extremes, from art to perfection of skill, counts as worship.
commandments: Try every new experience once unless it would be fatal.
Refuse to blend in; conformity erases the self.
Lure others into your pleasures and toward hedonism.
directives: Discover your greatest talent and become unrivalled in it.
Treat every moment as a chance for new sensation.
Never settle for a little; push life to its limits while you can.
Look after yourself first and grab all you can.
Discard shame; it only holds you back.

cults.name: Noise Marines
cults.summary: Surgically enhanced musicians who stage deafening free concerts that throw whole spheres into disorder and are banned in many places.

cults.name: The S Academy
cults.summary: An invitation-only elite school and open temple to Slaanesh where students pursue perfection in one talent to an obsessive degree.
